src/lib/security/checks.ts:82 The grade is how many workflow files contain a permissions key, plus a broad-write cap. It does not diff declared grants against the hosts or writes the steps perform.

src/lib/security/exposure.ts:60 The lockfile is parsed as JSON text. Workflow checks regex file contents. No eval, Function, or child_process spawn in src/lib/scan.ts, src/lib/analyze/index.ts, or src/lib/github/source.ts.
